articles.title: Deadly Mudslide Hits China-Nepal Border — At Least 72 Killed, Hundreds Missing
articles.summary: A powerful torrent of mud and floodwater swept through a mountain valley along the border between China and Nepal, killing at least 72 people and leaving more than 300 others unaccounted for. The disaster struck near the Shigatse region of Tibet after days of heavy seasonal rainfall caused rivers to burst their banks. Emergency rescue teams were deployed to search for survivors buried under debris in difficult terrain. China's President Xi Jinping issued urgent instructions calling for an all-out rescue effort. The border crossing between the two countries was temporarily closed. Scientists warn that climate change is making extreme weather events in high-altitude mountain areas increasingly common and dangerous.

lv1: What natural disaster happened along the China-Nepal border? (中國和尼泊爾邊境發生了什麼自然災害？)
How many people were reported missing after the disaster? (災難後有多少人被報告失蹤？)
lv2: Why do you think mountain regions like Tibet face especially high danger during heavy rainy seasons? (你認為為什麼像西藏這樣的山區在大雨季節面臨特別高的危險？)
What kinds of challenges would rescue teams face when searching for survivors in a remote mountain area? (救援人員在偏遠山區搜尋生還者時會面對哪些挑戰？)
lv3: Scientists say climate change is making extreme weather disasters worse. Do governments have a greater responsibility to protect communities living in high-risk mountain zones, even if it is costly? Why or why not? (科學家說氣候變化正令極端天氣災難惡化。政府是否有更大責任保護住在高風險山區的社區，即使代價高昂？為什麼？)

When a natural disaster crosses two countries' borders, how should nations like China and Nepal cooperate in rescue and recovery? What political or logistical difficulties might get in the way? (當自然災害跨越兩國邊境時，中國和尼泊爾等國應如何合作救援？可能會出現哪些政治或後勤上的困難？)

articles.title: Asia's Underground Water Is Disappearing Fast, Scientists Warn
articles.summary: A new scientific study has revealed that the region known as Asia's 'Water Tower' — covering the Tibetan Plateau and nearby mountain ranges — is losing around 24 billion tonnes of underground water every single year. This groundwater feeds major rivers across Asia that hundreds of millions of people rely on for drinking water, growing food, and everyday life. The losses are worst in densely populated farming regions. Scientists noted that melting glaciers may reduce the problem temporarily around the 2060s, but warned that without major changes to how water is used, the crisis will deepen significantly in the decades ahead.

lv1: What is the 'Asian Water Tower' and why is it important? (什麼是「亞洲水塔」？為什麼它很重要？)
Roughly how many tonnes of groundwater does Asia lose every year according to the study? (根據研究，亞洲每年大約損失多少噸地下水？)
lv2: Why is losing groundwater especially dangerous for farmers who live far from cities? (失去地下水對居住在遠離城市的農民來說為什麼特別危險？)
Scientists say glacier melt could temporarily ease the water shortage. Why is relying on glacier melt not a long-term solution? (科學家說冰川融化可以暫時緩解水源短缺。為什麼依賴冰川融化不是長遠解決方案？)
lv3: If underground water supplies run out, who do you think will suffer the most — people in cities or rural communities — and is it fair that some groups are more affected than others? (如果地下水供應耗盡，你認為誰會受苦最多——城市居民還是農村社區？某些群體受影響更大，這公平嗎？)

Some argue that farmers should be allowed to use as much water as they need to grow food for billions of people. Others say strict water limits are essential to prevent a future crisis. Which view do you agree with more, and why? (有人認為應允許農民使用所需的水來為數十億人種植糧食；另一些人則認為嚴格的用水限制對於防止未來危機至關重要。你更同意哪種觀點？為什麼？)

articles.title: 九龍醫院男病房8名病人現呼吸道感染病徵 醫管局暫停探訪
articles.summary: 醫院管理局宣布，九龍醫院一個持續護理男病房自上周二起，先後有八名病人出現發燒或呼吸道感染症狀。醫管局已即時啟動感染控制措施，包括暫停相關病房探訪，並安排受影響病人接受病毒測試。當局表示病人情況穩定，會繼續密切監察。醫生提醒市民，若出現咳嗽、發燒或呼吸困難等情況，應盡快求醫，同時減少前往人多密集場所，保護自己及他人。

lv1: 事件發生在哪間醫院？共有多少名病人出現病徵？
醫管局採取了什麼措施應對這次感染事件？
lv2: 為什麼醫院病房比一般地方更容易爆發呼吸道傳染病？
暫停探訪對病人和其家屬各有什麼影響？你認為這樣的決定值得嗎？
lv3: 醫院有責任保護公眾健康，但同時病人家屬也有探望至親的需要。你認為在感染爆發期間，醫院應如何在兩者之間取得平衡？
香港公立醫院長期面對病床不足、病房擠迫的問題。你認為這是否令傳染病更容易擴散？政府應採取哪些根本性措施改善醫療系統？

articles.title: 尼泊爾邊境爆發大規模泥石流 洪水衝入西藏日喀則 逾300人失蹤
articles.summary: 尼泊爾北部邊境昨日爆發嚴重泥石流，大量山泥與洪水沿峽谷急速湧入中國西藏日喀則市邊境地帶，造成至少七十二人罹難，逾三百人下落不明。事故由持續強降雨引發，令山坡土石鬆動崩塌。中方已緊急派出搜救人員在惡劣環境中全力搜尋生還者，兩國邊境口岸亦暫時關閉。專家指出，喜馬拉雅山脈一帶近年受極端天氣影響，山泥傾瀉及洪澇災害頻率顯著上升，對當地居民構成嚴峻威脅。

lv1: 今次泥石流發生在哪兩個國家的邊境附近？
事故造成多少人死亡及失蹤？
lv2: 持續大雨為何容易引發山區泥石流？請嘗試解釋箇中原因。
搜救人員在山區邊境地帶工作時，會面對哪些特別困難？
lv3: 氣候變化令極端天氣愈來愈頻繁，鄰近山區的國家是否有責任共同建立預警系統及跨境救援機制？你認為國際合作在應對自然災害方面有多重要？
有意見認為山區過度開發（例如修路、建設）加劇了泥石流的風險。你認同嗎？在經濟發展與保護自然環境之間，社會應如何作出取捨？
